personality_one_liner: A fast, premium, and trustworthy invoicing tool that focuses on financial clarity and operational speed, completely avoiding generic AI aesthetics.

spacing.rule: Generous padding around content. Empty space is content on purpose. Keep inputs and buttons minimum 44pt tall. Use 8pt grid logic.

do's: Use frosted glass on the bottom tab bar
Use glass on sticky headers over scrollable content (like Invoice list)
Use glass on sticky Bottom CTA panels (like 'Save Invoice' in the builder)
dont's: Never use on normal cards, form fields, or body text regions

screens.name: Auth

states.error: Inline text below input or bottom-sheet toast.

screens.layout: Minimalist header with brand mark. Single column layout. Large, airy text inputs. Primary CTA sticky at bottom inside KeyboardAvoidingView.

screens.name: Onboarding Wizard
screens.layout: Full-bleed onboarding image at top with vertical gradient scrim, followed by setup form. Step indicator at the top. Sticky 'Next' CTA at bottom.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: High-level financial overview and quick actions.

states.loading: Skeleton cards for revenue and chart.
states.empty: Empty state illustration 'Create your first invoice to see insights'.
states.error: Readable message 'Unable to load dashboard' + Retry button.

screens.layout: Hero section: Multi-column grid (Revenue, Outstanding, Overdue). Below: 6-month simple bar chart. Below: Recent Invoices (list of rows). Floating Action Button (FAB) '+ New Invoice' placed sticky at bottom right. Glass sticky header on scroll.

screens.name: New Invoice (AI vs Manual)
screens.purpose: Create invoices either via plain English AI prompt or manual builder.

states.loading: Full screen 'AI is drafting your invoice...' with abstract animation.
states.error: Error boundary above manual builder 'AI couldn't process that, please try again or enter manually'.

screens.layout: Split path at top via segmented control or toggle. AI Path: Large text input area (surfaceTertiary background) + 'Generate Draft' CTA. Manual Path: Form layout with inline-create bottom sheet for customers/items. 'Live Totals' panel fixed at bottom inside a glass container, along with 'Preview & Save' button.

screens.name: Invoice List
screens.purpose: View, filter, and search all invoices.

states.empty: Minimalist notepad illustration with text 'No invoices match this filter'.

screens.layout: Sticky glass header containing Search bar and horizontally scrolling Status Filter Chips (All, Draft, Sent, Paid, Overdue). Below: Vertically scrolling list of invoice cards. Cards display customer, amount, due date, and a colored status pill.

screens.name: Invoice Detail (PDF Preview)
screens.purpose: Preview the invoice and perform actions (Share, Mark Paid).
screens.layout: A styled, print-like preview (white card with subtle border on light gray bg) rendering the line items and totals. Sticky action bar at the bottom with: Share (Native sheet), Record Payment, and an options menu (Void, Duplicate).

screens.name: Customers
screens.purpose: Manage client list and view lifetime value.

states.empty: Illustration 'No customers added yet' + 'Add Customer' CTA.

screens.layout: Search bar at top. List of customer rows (Avatar fallback to initials). Tapping opens a bottom sheet with their contact info, lifetime revenue, and invoice history.

screens.name: Catalog
screens.layout: List of items showing name, unit price, and tax rate. FAB to add new.

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: Manage business profile, plan, and Anthropic API keys.
screens.layout: Categorized list rows (Business Profile, API Key, Plan/Subscription) grouped in surfaceSecondary cards. Subscription section prominently shows current usage (e.g., '3/5 Invoices Used').

onboarding_hero.alt: Professional desk setup with laptop, representing business management.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the iOS-Native Clean layout principles. Use generous padding (16pt to 24pt) around the screen edges.
BANNED: Any shade of blue, purple, or indigo. Stick to the provided warm charcoal, sand, and deep emerald (brand) colors. This app must feel like a premium finance tool, not generic AI software.
Typography: Use Plus Jakarta Sans. Maximum font weight is 500. Use sizing for hierarchy, not boldness.
Implement the 'Sticky Primary CTA' pattern inside a glass container or solid surface over scrolling content (e.g., in the New Invoice manual builder).
All cards must span full width horizontally minus screen padding (no 48% widths clustered to the left).
Invoice Status Pills styling: Draft (surfaceTertiary/onSurfaceTertiary), Sent (warning/onWarning), Paid (success/onSuccess), Overdue (error/onError).
Ensure the AI text input area in the 'New Invoice' screen is large, inviting, and clearly distinguishable from standard form fields (use surfaceTertiary with ample padding).
Incorporate subtle haptic feedback for bottom-sheet openings, chip selections, and primary CTA interactions.
Render text on the onboarding image using the gradient-to-dark scrim pattern (Layer 0: Image, Layer 1: Vertical gradient transparent to surfaceInverse 70%+, Layer 2: Text).
